network.scope: Only scripts/release_skill.py may use the configured GitHub origin and the public GitHub Releases API while publishing this skill repository.
network.reason: The user requires each skill change to push the main branch and version tag and verify the resulting GitHub Release without sending target-project data.

target_enforcement.openai: metadata-only permission contract; release still requires operator-authorized local execution
target_enforcement.claude: adapter permission contract; release still requires operator-authorized local execution
target_enforcement.generic: adapter permission contract; release still requires operator-authorized local execution
target_enforcement.vscode: workspace-trust plus adapter permission contract; release still requires operator-authorized local execution

file_read.scope: Project-owned regression catalog, profiles, module manifests, checks, native-test inventory, UI/design surface inventory, known failures, repository paths, and applicable project instructions selected for the active task.
file_read.reason: Complete regression coverage requires deterministic structure and reference auditing before execution.

file_write.scope: Only scripts/release_skill.py may update this skill repository's manifest version and README version markers before its focused Git commit.
file_write.reason: Deterministic version updates are required for the user-authorized governed skill release and are limited to the current skill repository.

target_enforcement.openai: metadata-only permission contract; writes remain limited by the local script and repository
target_enforcement.claude: adapter permission contract; writes remain limited by the local script and repository
target_enforcement.generic: adapter permission contract; writes remain limited by the local script and repository
target_enforcement.vscode: workspace-trust plus adapter permission contract; writes remain limited by the local script and repository

subprocess.scope: Only a detected project-owned regression/run.php, run.py, run.ps1, or run.sh entrypoint with validated changed, all, module, profile, and base arguments; no shell evaluation and no manifest-controlled executable.
subprocess.reason: The skill must execute the authoritative project regression gate while preventing arbitrary command injection from manifests.

target_enforcement.openai: metadata-only permission contract; subprocess execution requires explicit project runner arguments
target_enforcement.claude: adapter permission contract; subprocess execution requires explicit project runner arguments
target_enforcement.generic: adapter permission contract; subprocess execution requires explicit project runner arguments
target_enforcement.vscode: workspace-trust plus adapter permission contract; subprocess execution requires explicit project runner arguments

subprocess.risk_boundary: Migration, production, deployment, node-control, credentialed, and real-device profiles still require the authority and prerequisites defined by the target project.
